pin_regs.reason: KV-RTRUNK: a result-trunk station is ONE register stage pin to pin (inject: a / y -> 2:1 -> flop -> b; header: trunk words -> AND / 2:1 -> flop -> beat word); its flop is the pin register of every pin; pv_trunk_gen counts exactly 1 core cycle per station (RS_D), so a flow-inserted pin register would change the static beat schedule; KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: the native successor registers / replicates its select pins in RTL instead

job.purpose: KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: PV result-trunk HEADER with replicated T0 V / T selects (a0v/a1v 31 copies + a0t/a1t, from the last strip relays spare bits; KV=32 -> 16 data muxes per copy), 190.08 x 43.2 um; successor of qkd_pv_rs_hd (native capture a1[256] 274.5 > 190)

structural_change: KV-KITS/NATIVE 10-18: native-pin successor of qkd_pv_rs_hd (CLOSED, not die-bindable: native capture FAIL on its select pins only). qkd_pv_rs_hd a<q>[256] / [257] fanned out to 512 data muxes / 42 loads (S + R 274.5 / 221.8 ps); here 32 V copies (16 loads each) and 2 T copies. Same beat schedule, 0 cycles (pv_trunk_gen default; --rs-legacy keeps qkd_pv_rs_hd).
